title: FieldRT: Reconfigurable Architecture from Geometric Sensitivity to Streaming Acceleration
summary: FieldRT uses geometric-sensitivity analysis to choose an oriented bird’s-eye-view detector profile and map retained operations to a streaming hardware design. Tests with the AFN detector showed task-dependent trade-offs among dense prediction and instance-detection measures; custom programmable-logic primitives reached numerical closure on an AMD Kria KV260.
